_read_me: YOUR AGENCY IN ONE FILE. The first run copies this to agency/config.json (kept on this PC only, never uploaded: a tracked file edited on the PC would block the bot's auto-update). Change every YOUR ... word in agency/config.json, save, run tools/bat/RUN_AGENCY.bat again. The pitches, emails and demo sites read their names, numbers and prices from it.

agency.name: YOUR AGENCY
agency.postal_address: YOUR STREET ADDRESS, YOUR CITY, ST 00000
agency.tagline: Websites for local businesses, ready the same day
agency.terms: Month to month: cancel any time.

packages.name: Starter site
packages.pitch: The easiest yes: a fast, clean site for the business with no site or a broken one, with the care plan always attached.
includes: Up to 5 pages: home, services, about, reviews, contact
Tap-to-call and a contact form that emails them
Works great on phones; loads in about a second
Their own domain set up (in their name)

packages.name: Call engine
packages.pitch: More calls from the map: site + Google profile + review requests + every review answered. It compounds: more reviews, more map calls, and it rarely cancels.
includes: A one-page call site (or a tune-up of their current one)
Google Business Profile set up and kept fresh (posts, photos, hours)
Review requests by text after every job (they approve the wording)
A one-page proof report each month: calls, reviews, map views in plain words
Works for any local service: trades, salons, clinics, shops

packages.name: 3D Signature
packages.pitch: The site people remember: a phone-scan 3D tour of their space or a 3D product page you can spin with a finger (AR on phones), still fast.
includes: A 3D tour of their space (venues, gyms, studios, salons) or 3D product pages for 5-10 products (makers, dealers)
View in your room (AR) on iPhone and Android
A still-image fallback for old phones and reduced motion
Speed checked on a real phone before launch
Care plan: hosting, updates, small edits
